inherited_c05.scope: Original five PASS remain pinned to their original W. They are not automatically transported to the new producer. Only the resolve/reuse case is additionally selected for a concrete changed path; the other four are not rerun.

execution_controls.deduplication: Compared existing runs/requests before each dispatch. Second request starts only after the first run and cleanup complete. No matching receipt request already existed.

static_checks.final_gate: Existing Astra WP08 checks will execute on the evidence delivery HEAD. Its exact HEAD/tree/run/job/artifact, diagnostic comparison and guards result are published in PR41 after this commit to avoid recursive evidence commits. No baseline gate is attributed to W.

requirements: Consume the published producer by SHA and value.mutationReceipt.
Persist the complete pending intent in the browser and restore the exact original key/body/expectedStorageVersion under fresh admission.
Match ACK to intent/principal/key/thread/exact message tuple; never use current projection, text, author, position or Boolean as identity.
Qualify composed UI positive ACK, lost response/retry/reload, equal messages, divergence, revocation and source replacement.
Keep ACK separate from human confirmation, attachment/reuse approval and financial authorization.
